γήθησέν: γηθέω — rejoice, be glad; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγήθησεν); extra accent from the enclitic τ’
δάμασ: δαμάζω (δάμνημι) — overpower, subdue; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (δάμασ’ = δάμασσε; Attic ἐδάμασε)
δύνασαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic δύνασαι/δύνῃ): ’you can, you are able’
εἴρυτο: ἐρύω (εἰρύω) — draw, pull; plpf. 3 sg. mid., epic: ’had drawn’ (a sword); the same letters can also belong to ἐρύομαι ’guard’ · also ἐρύομαι — guard, keep; impf. 3 sg. mid., epic (Attic ἐρρύετο, from ῥύομαι): ’guarded, kept’
εἶπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable
κλῦθι: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’hear!’ (regular opening of a prayer)
κρῆθεν: κρῆθεν — from the head, down from above (κάρη + -θεν); adv.
κτεινόμενος: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. sg.: ’being killed’
λελασμένος: λανθάνω — escape notice; mid. forget (+ acc./gen.); perf. part. mid., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic λελησμένος): ’having forgotten’
μενέαινε: μενεαίνω — be eager, be set on, rage; impf. 3 sg. (+ inf.): ’was eager’
νεμεσσήθητε: νεμεσάω — feel righteous indignation; aor. imper. 2 pl., epic double σ (νεμεσσήθητε)
οἷοί: οἷος — such as, of the kind that; masc. nom. pl., correlative/relative, accented before the enclitic τε
πατροκλῆος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ companion; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έους)
τεῖρε: τείρω — wear down, distress, oppress; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτειρε)
φθογγῆς: φθογγή — voice, sound; fem. gen. sg., governed by ἠκούομεν
ἀκούειν: ἀκούω — hear, listen to; pres. inf.
ἀνέρι: ἀνήρ — man, husband; dat. sg.: ’to a husband’ · also dat. sg. of the person concerned: ’for a man’
ἀρείους: ἀγαθός — good; irregular comparative ἀρείων, masc. nom. pl. ἀρείους, + gen. of comparison: ’better than’
ἁδινὸν: ἁδινός — thick, close-packed, crowded; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, of weeping: ’in a thick flood, heavily’ · also of lowing cattle: ’heavily’ (ἁδινὸν μυκώμεναι)
ἐλήλαται: ἐλαύνω — drive, drive along, extend; perf. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’has been driven (round)’
ἐποτρύνω: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, rouse; pres. subj. 1 sg. (purpose clause)
ἔρχαται: εἴργω (ἔργω) — shut in, pen; perf. pass. 3 pl., Ionic -αται (= Attic εἰργμένοι εἰσί): ’are penned’
ἕρμα: ἕρμα — prop, support, bulwark; neut. acc. sg.
ἤκουσε: ἀκούω — hear, hear of (+ gen.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’heard’
ῥῖνάς: ῥίς — nose, nostril (distinct from ῥινός ’skin, hide’); fem. acc. pl.
